entries.zh: 叩见：低头俯身、全身下拜以示敬意（晋见行礼）
entries.en: to bow the head and whole body in reverence; to kotow on being received in audience

entries.zh: 叩拜：低头行拜礼
entries.en: to bow the head in obeisance; to make a bow of reverence

entries.zh: 俯：低头、俯首（因某事而低下去）
entries.en: to bow (stoop) the head; to lower the head for something

entries.zh: 俯仰：低头与抬头看；低头而视
entries.en: to bow the head and look; bowing and raising the head
entries.notes: H 栏「俯仰」兼含低头与抬头二义，L 仅作低头而视，故降为 medium。

entries.zh: 叩谢：向尊长叩头致谢
entries.en: to bow the head before a superior in thanks; to kotow in gratitude

entries.zh: 顿：以头触地行礼
entries.en: to strike the head on the ground in reverence; to bow the head to the floor

entries.zh: 顿首拜：叩头至地而拜
entries.en: to bow the head to the ground in obeisance; to perform the full kotow

entries.zh: 踩倒；踏倒（踩踏使倒下）
entries.en: to trample down; to tread down
entries.notes: L 栏「por piedra y grime」疑为讹写，H 栏 [疑:採/踩]，据 M/R chây tò 取「踩倒」义。

entries.zh: 和息：平息争讼；退出争执、和解了事
entries.en: to withdraw from a quarrel or lawsuit; to settle a dispute amicably

entries.zh: 放下；放开（让孩子去吃饭）
entries.en: to put down; to let go (of children, to go and eat)
entries.notes: L 栏前半「Baxar la cabeza &」疑为衍文，H/M/R 三栏一致指「放下」。

entries.zh: 横：横着放置、横挂（帐幔之类）
entries.en: to lay or hang crosswise; horizontal (of a hanging cloth)
entries.notes: L 栏「baxarla boca la colgadura」文义残缺，依 H「橫」与 M hûã 定横放之义。

entries.zh: 扳落来：把东西（如树枝）拉下来；放下
entries.en: to pull down (as a tree branch); to bring down
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:枋/扳]，从 L「如树枝般拉下」与 M pâng lò lây 取「扳落來」。

entries.zh: 扯落来：扶持着把东西缓缓放下
entries.en: to lower (something) while holding it up; to pull down with support
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:撦/撆]，L 作 sustentándolo（扶持着），M chê lò lây 近「扯落來」。

entries.zh: 下马；在难行处离鞍而下（原文作「落梢」）
entries.en: to dismount from the saddle at a bad passage
entries.notes: H 栏「落梢」[疑:梢/稍] 非常语且 T99 污损，然 L 义清楚，据以立释。

entries.zh: 下手：把手放下；动手去做（某事）
entries.en: to lower the hand; to put one's hand to (something)

entries.zh: 减价；把价钱减得过多
entries.en: to lower the price; to knock down the price (excessively)

entries.zh: 下：下面、底下；低处
entries.en: below, down; underneath; the lower part

entries.zh: 低：低卑；成色低的（银）
entries.en: low (in nature and morals); of low carat (silver)
entries.notes: L 栏「depues quilates ue plata」严重讹写，H「低」与 R tī 可定「低」，涉银成色之细节存疑。

entries.zh: 卑：卑下、低微（地位或品性）
entries.en: low, base, humble; of low station

entries.zh: 卑贱：地位低贱；下贱之人
entries.en: low and base; a vile, lowly person

entries.zh: 卑下：卑下、下贱（指人）
entries.en: lowly, base (of a person)
entries.notes: L 栏后半「asqueroso que dice asial y habla」讹误难通，H/M/R 三栏一致为「卑下」。
